notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/stanfordvl__gibsonenv --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached and no hardware or upstream run is claimed. The card's mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim was not used: the clone needs gym==0.9.4 and pybullet==1.9.4 (setup.py:26-30), an Nvidia CUDA/CuDNN GPU (README.md:67-69) and separately downloaded scene assets, and its registered gym ids point at the absent realenv package (gibson/__init__.py:14-34); the gate installs and imports nothing. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python stand-in for the AntNavigateEnv interface: Discrete(17) actions, the nonviz_sensor array of 28 values clipped to [-5, 5], the 300-frame termination and the (obs, reward, done, info) step shape. It does not reproduce PyBullet contacts, joint torques, friction, the camera modalities or upstream trajectories, and it was never compared with the upstream environment; those omissions are in the fidelity gaps. NOT COVERED: the rgb_filled, depth, normal and semantics camera arrays (the package serves the nonviz_sensor configuration, which the fake returns at its real 28-value size). The sim backend (gym.make with env_id AntNavigateEnv) was not run and is not a registered gym id; env_id names the direct environment class the README documents, because the registered ids are stale. The family's reset options input is advertised by the bridge but the clone's reset takes no keyword arguments; the fake refuses non-empty options rather than silently ignoring them. The five warnings are the expected ones for a Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.index and seed twice). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was reported. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue requests; no x-cap id, no operator-required limit and no site-limits overlay. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last run printed.
